lines: Shivraj Singh Kandhari, guardian of Bikramjit Singh Kandhari, is due proceeds from selling 100 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds are ₹0.00 crore, listing scheduled for On or about Friday, October 23, 2026, per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds are slightly lower than the offer price shows.
Caveat: role and pre-offer holding are unknown, so retained stake cannot be discussed yet.
